basic_info.main_problem: I feel everyone sees me as a 'tomboy' because I like playing softball, which makes me believe I will not have Female friends. This feeling started in adolescence and continues into adulthood, especially noticeable in Social situations like Meeting new friends or interacting with Female colleagues.

growth_experiences: Worrying in adolescence about being labeled a 'tomboy' for loving softball, developing the self-assumption that 'Females will not accept me'; this experience continues into adulthood, repeatedly triggered when meeting new Females or interacting with Female colleagues, causing tension, hesitation to approach, and Self-doubt.

I am different from other Females, destined to hardly have Female friends
